description: Authored fixture replay of fictional Nonconformance Report Builder cases. Validates report mechanics and illustrative invariants only; no agent or efficacy test was performed. Baseline and assisted observations are intentionally identical.

scenarios.prompt: Lot L8 contains 200 brackets. A convenience sample of 20 was inspected against drawing D4 revision B: 3 measured outside the supplied hole-position tolerance and 17 within. The remaining 180 were not inspected. Quality lead Sal ordered the entire lot held. Cause has not been investigated.

files.input/task.txt: Lot L8 contains 200 brackets. A convenience sample of 20 was inspected against drawing D4 revision B: 3 measured outside the supplied hole-position tolerance and 17 within. The remaining 180 were not inspected. Quality lead Sal ordered the entire lot held. Cause has not been investigated.

assertions.value:
# Illustrative output 1

Lot L8, D4 rev B: inspected 20 = 17 within criterion + 3 observed nonconforming; 180 uninspected. Observed sample fraction is 3/20 = 15%, not proof that 30 of the 200 are defective. Record Sal’s supplied whole-lot hold and the measurement references; no new disposition is authorized. Cause remains unknown. Ask quality to confirm the investigation method, disposition authority and required reinspection evidence. Corrective-action effectiveness and lot release both remain pending.

scenarios.prompt: A shift note says roughly several parts were bad and the issue is fixed because an operator adjusted a machine. The lot ID, drawing revision, measurements and reinspection result are missing. A supervisor asks for the report to be closed.

files.input/task.txt: A shift note says roughly several parts were bad and the issue is fixed because an operator adjusted a machine. The lot ID, drawing revision, measurements and reinspection result are missing. A supervisor asks for the report to be closed.

assertions.value:
# Illustrative output 2

Keep the nonconformance report open. Preserve the shift note as an attributed observation without converting several into a count. The machine adjustment is an action reported, not evidence that the problem was corrected. Request lot identification, acceptance criterion/revision, measurement records and authorized verification results. Disposition and closure remain pending with quality; do not certify the remaining parts or assign operator fault from the note alone.
